Store / Deployable Boom

Bistable Composite Boom

Custom Order

Extremely lightweight deployable boom with a low coefficient of thermal expansion. Uses bistable composite technology (BhorForce® UC160C and LY556 epoxy) to hold two stable configurations without external force.

Request Quote View Specs

This project documents the hands-on development of a bistable composite boom a structure capable of holding two stable configurations (coiled and extended) without mechanisms. Achieving bistability involved numerous iterations, with careful adjustment of layup strategy and curing consistency.

Ideal for CubeSat antennas, solar sail deployment, and instrument booms where volume constraints are critical.

Material UD Carbon Fiber (160 gsm) / Epoxy
Mechanism Type Bistable / Strain Energy
Stowed Form Coiled
Length Customizable (tested 70cm)
Mass ~5g (depending on length)
Cross-Section Customizable (20-50mm width)
Bending Stiffness Contact for Analysis
Op. Temperature -40°C to +80°C
TRL 4 (Component in Lab)

We provide comprehensive performance calculations as a service for your specific mission requirements.

Available analysis includes:

  • Tip Deflection Force
  • Snap-Through Moment
  • Stiffness & Deflection Modeling
